blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: DeepLearning (DL)-based Computer-Aided Diagnostic (CAD) systems have shown great promise in supporting clinicians, but their performance heavily depends on the availability of large, well-annotated datasets. In medical lesion detection, the scarcity of comprehensive, stan dardized annotations and the heterogeneity of existing datasets limit the development of robust foundation models. In this work, we introduce a novel approach to building a multi-domain foundation model for le sion detection by integrating diverse medical image datasets annotated for both anatomical structures and abnormalities. We first propose a student-teacher training strategy to effectively combine datasets with heterogeneous label spaces, mitigating catastrophic forgetting, and im proving feature learning. In addition, building on our previously pro posed example-based EM-DETR framework, we adapt it to jointly learn from multiple domain-specific datasets, enabling fine-grained, example driven detection across modalities. Our model achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results, with image-level AUC scores exceeding previous SOTA by 1% point on four key findings in CXRs. We achieve a leading mAP50 in CXRs and mammography, surpassing EM-DETR trained on a single dataset by 2-3% points. This approach paves the way for scalable foundation models in medical imaging that leverage heterogeneous data while maintaining robust and generalizable performance.
blocks.zh: 以DeepLearning(DL)为基础的计算机辅助诊断(CAD)系统在支持临床医生方面表现出了巨大的希望,但其性能很大程度上取决于是否有大型的,精心说明的数据集. 在医学损伤检测中,缺乏全面而有分量的说明和现有数据集的异质性限制了稳健的基础模型的发展. 在这部作品中,我们引入了一种新的方法,通过整合对解剖结构和异常情况附加说明的多种医学图像数据集,为le sion检测建立一个多领域的基础模型. 我们首先提出一个学生-教师培训战略,将数据集与不同的标签空间有效地结合起来,减轻灾难性的遗忘,并证明特征学习。 此外,我们利用我们先前提出的以实例为基础的EM-DETR框架,对其进行调整,以便共同学习多个特定域的数据集,从而能够进行精细、以实例驱动的跨模式检测。 我们的模型实现了最先进的(SOTA)结果,在CXRs的4个关键发现上,图像级别AUC的分数超过了以前的SOTA1%. 我们在CXRs和乳房X光学中实现了领先的mAP50,超过EM-DETR在单一数据集上训练的2-3%分. 这种方法为医学成像中可扩展的基础模型铺平了道路,这些模型利用了各种数据,同时保持了有力和可概括的性能。

blocks.en: 1 Motivation
blocks.zh: 1 动机

blocks.en: Object detection is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, finding extensive use in fields such as autonomous driving, robotics, and surveillance. In medical imaging, detection plays an equally critical role, enabling the identification and localization of anatomical structures or pathological findings that guide clinical decision making. Traditional CNN-based detection models such as Faster R-CNN [ 21 ] , RetinaNet [ 12 ] , and FCOS [ 24 ] have demonstrated strong performance in natural image domains and have also been adapted for radiographic tasks [ 7 ] . However, these models often rely on extensive, dataset-specific supervision and struggle to generalize across modalities or out-of-distribution (OOD) data [ 1 ] . This is primarily due to the intricate nature of obtaining high-quality annotations, the subtle visual indicators that complicate the defining of boundary regions, and the diversity of anatomical structures [ 18 , 22 ] .
blocks.zh: 物体探测是计算机视觉中的一项根本挑战,发现在自主驾驶,机器人,监视等领域广泛使用. 在医学成像中,检测具有同等的关键作用,能够识别和本地化指导临床决策的解剖结构或病理发现. 传统的基于CNN的探测模型,如更快的R-CNN[21],RetinaNet[12],FCOS[24],在自然图像领域表现出了强大的性能,也因辐射任务而进行了改造[7]. 然而,这些模型往往依赖于广泛的、针对数据集的监督,并努力将各种模式或非分配(OO)数据加以概括[1]。 这主要是因为获得高质量说明的性质复杂,视觉指标微妙,使界定边界区域的工作复杂化,以及解剖结构的多样性[18、22]。

blocks.en: To address the limitations of supervised object detectors, recent work has explored Vision-Language (VL) detection models [ 10 , 14 , 8 , 16 , 17 ] that integrate image and text supervision during training. These models show strong potential for generalizing across novel classes and domains, particularly in natural image settings. Models such as GLIP [ 10 ] , OWL-ViT [ 17 ] , and Grounding DINO [ 14 ] achieve state-of-the-art detection performance by leveraging powerful, jointly learned visual and language embeddings, which are aligned through contrastive learning. Moreover, large-scale pretraining on “grounding” or “caption” datasets i.e., region-level textual descriptions, enables open-set zero-shot detection, allowing recognition of unseen classes from their textual cues. This pretraining leverages automatically mined image-caption pairs from extensive web sources and curated datasets, including LAION-400M [ 23 ] , Visual Genome [ 9 ] , and COCO Captions [ 5 ] .
blocks.zh: 为了解决受监督物体探测器的局限性,最近的工作探索了在培训期间将图像和文字监督结合起来的Visual-Language(VL)探测模型[10、14、8、16、17]。 这些模式显示,特别是在自然图像环境中,在新颖的类别和领域中广泛推广的潜力很大。 GLIP [10],OWL-ViT [17],以及Grounding DINO [14]等模型,通过利用强大的,共同学习的视觉和语言嵌入,通过对比性学习对齐,实现最先进的检测性能. 此外,关于“铺设”或“封装”数据集的大规模预训,即区域一级的文字描述,可以打开设置零发探测器,从文字提示中识别看不见的类。 这种预训杠杆会自动从广泛的网络来源和整理的数据集中挖掘出图像封装对,包括LAION-400M [23],视觉基因组[9],以及COCO Captions [5].

blocks.en: In contrast, the medical domain lacks comparable comprehensive image-text paired datasets, posing challenges for effective VL model training. Medical image annotations are sparse [ 18 , 19 ] , domain-specific, and expensive to obtain [ 6 ] , often requiring expert knowledge and adherence to stringent annotation protocols. Consequently, the development of a similar foundational model for medical lesion detection continues to pose significant challenges. In this study, we initially examine two distinct datasets: annotated for anatomical structures and abnormalities, with the goal of enhancing the visual feature space during baseline training. While this approach offers modest gains, we extend it further by leveraging our previously proposed EM-DETR [ 1 ] framework. Specifically, we use EM-DETR [ 1 ] , an example-based multi-modal detector accepted at MICCAI 2025, to integrate multiple domain-specific datasets, allowing the model to learn fine-grained, example-based features tailored to distinct lesion types across various imaging contexts.
blocks.zh: 相比之下,医疗领域缺乏可比较的综合图像文本配对数据集,对有效的VL模型培训构成挑战. 医疗图像说明很少[18,19],具体领域,获得[6]费用昂贵,往往需要专家知识和遵守严格的注释协议。 因此,开发类似的医疗伤情检测基本模式继续构成重大挑战。 在这项研究中,我们首先审查两个截然不同的数据集:解剖结构和异常性注释,目的是在基线训练中增强视觉特征空间. 虽然这一办法略有成效,但我们通过利用我们先前提议的EM-DETR[1]框架,进一步扩大了这一办法。 具体地说,我们使用EM-DETR [1],一种在MICCAI 2025中被接受的以实例为基础的多模式探测器,整合了多个特定域的数据集,使模型能够学习精细的,以实例为基础的特性,适合不同成像背景的不同损伤类型.

blocks.en: Our contributions are twofold: (1) we explore combining anatomical and abnormality annotations to enrich supervision during training, and (2) we extend EM-DETR to develop a multi-domain, example-based foundation detection model that achieves state-of-the-art (SOTA) results across five key findings in CXRs and mammography. The remainder of the paper is organized as follows: Section 2 details the datasets used, covering both anatomical and abnormality annotations. Section 3 outlines the two methods of developing a foundation model. Section 4 presents experimental results, and Section 5 concludes with discussion and future directions.
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有两个方面:(1) 我们探索将解剖学和异常学说明结合起来,以丰富培训期间的监督;(2) 我们扩展EM-DETR,以开发一个多领域、以实例为基础的基础检测模型,在CXRs和乳房X光学的五个关键发现中实现最新结果。 该文件的其余部分如下: 第2节详细介绍了所使用的数据集,包括解剖和异常说明。 第3节概述了制定基础模型的两种方法。 第4节介绍实验结果,第5节最后讨论和未来的方向。

blocks.en: 2 Datasets
blocks.zh: 2个数据集

blocks.en: This work utilises four image datasets across two modalities: Chest X-Rays (CXRs) and mammography. These include a private dataset annotated for key anatomical structures, two datasets with abnormality-level labels (private [ 6 ] and public [ 18 ] ), and an additional public mammography dataset [ 19 ] annotated for abnormalities at the lesion level. The details of each dataset, including annotation types, and class distribution, are described below.
blocks.zh: 这项工作利用了两种模式的4个图像数据集: 胸X射线(CXR)和乳房造影术. 其中包括一个对关键解剖结构附加注释的私人数据集,两个带有异常级标签的数据集(私有[6]和公[18]),以及另一个公共乳房X光照相数据集[19]对损伤级异常附加注释. 每一数据集的细节,包括注释类型和类分布如下。

blocks.en: Dataset A , B A,B
blocks.zh: 数据集A、B、B

blocks.en: are two separate data subsets formed from a larger dataset acquired from multiple sites within the United States and Europe. This dataset includes frontal and lateral chest exams from adult cohorts ( > > 18 years). For annotation, two general radiologists independently reviewed all CXRs for the presence and location of 16 findings. A third general radiologist served as an independent tiebreaker for discrepant findings. Dataset 𝒜 \mathcal{A} consists of 15,000 full-resolution frontal view images with heart and lung annotations. Here we divide the lung annotations into right lung and left lung class. The dataset ℬ \mathcal{B} consists of 16,953 full resolution frontal view images with bounding boxes that indicate the presence of 16 findings, provided by an expert panel of radiologists. We employ four expert radiologist-provided gold-standard datasets for evaluation. These test datasets are binary classified and annotated for the presence or absence of each finding. These include 333 images for both atelectasis and consolidation, 331 images for pleural effusion, and 412 images for pneumothorax. Table 1 presents the distribution of findings in the training and test datasets. There is no patient overlap between the training and test datasets.
blocks.zh: 是从美国和欧洲多个地点获取的更大数据集形成的两个独立的数据子集。 该数据集包括成人群体( > 18岁)的胸前和横向检查。 关于说明,两名一般放射学家独立审查了所有CXR,以确定16项调查结果的存在和位置。 第三个普通放射科医生担任了独立断裂器,负责发现分歧。 Dataset A \ mathcal{A} 由 15,000 个带有心脏和肺部说明的全分辨率前视图像组成 。 在这里,我们将肺注分为右肺和左肺类. 数据集B\mathcal{B}由16,953个全分辨率前视图像组成,其边框显示存在16个发现,由放射学家专家小组提供. 我们使用四个专家放射学家提供的黄金标准数据集进行评估。 这些测试数据集是二进制分类和附加说明,说明每个发现是否存在. 这些图像包括333张用于Atelectasis和合并的图像,331张用于胸膜洗涤的图像,412张用于肺炎的图像. 表1列示了培训和测试数据集调查结果的分布情况。 培训与测试数据集之间没有病人重叠。

blocks.en: Table 1: Distribution of positive findings in training and test sets of dataset ℬ \mathcal{B} . The training dataset consists of a total 16,953 images with at-least one abnormality. Images may have multiple findings, hence % represent the proportion of total findings.
blocks.zh: 表1:在数据集B\mathcal{B}的培训和测试中得出的积极结果的分布情况。 培训数据集包括总共16 953幅至少一个异常的图像。 图像可能有多种结果,因此%代表总结果的比例。

blocks.en: Dataset 𝒞 \mathcal{C}
blocks.zh: 数据集 C\ mathcal{C}

blocks.en: is the public VinDR-CXR dataset [ 18 ] , comprising 18,000 CXR images manually annotated by a team of 17 experienced radiologists. Annotations include 22 local labels, provided as bounding boxes around abnormalities, and 6 global labels indicating suspected diseases. The dataset is split into 15,000 training, and 3,000 test images.
blocks.zh: 是公共 VinDR-CXR 数据集 [18], 由 17 位有经验的放射学家组成的团队手动注释的 18,000 CXR 图像组成. 说明包括22个地方标签,作为围绕异常的边框提供,以及6个显示可疑疾病的全球标签。 数据集分为15 000个培训,3 000个测试图像。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Overview of the student-teacher training process to create a foundation model with GDINO [ 14 ] . A GDINO model is trained on each dataset with all available classes and used to generate weak annotations on remaining sets. A final model is trained in phase II with both gold-standard and generated annotations. The model outputs both predicted bounding boxes and classification scores for each box.
blocks.zh: 图1:与GDINO建立基础模式的学生-教师培训过程概述 [14]. 一个GDINO模型在每一个数据集上都经过了所有可用课程的培训,并用于生成关于剩余数据集的微弱注释. 最后一种模式在第二阶段得到训练,既有黄金标准,也有产生的说明。 模型输出了每个框的预测边框和分类分数。

blocks.en: Dataset ℳ \mathcal{M}
blocks.zh: 数据集 M\ mathcal{M}

blocks.en: is the public VinDR-Mammo dataset [ 19 ] , comprising 5,000 full-field digital mammography (FFDM) exams, each with four standard views: craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) for both left and right breasts. Each exam was independently double-read by two radiologists, with any discrepancies resolved by a third radiologist. The dataset includes breast-level annotations following the Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS), covering assessment categories, breast density, and findings such as masses, calcifications, and architectural distortions. In particular, the dataset consists of images from a Vietnamese population with a typically high breast density (90% of density C & D), which renders the detection of mass a challenging task. There are a total of 15,000 images in the training dataset of which 50% are normal images, and 4,000 images in the test dataset. The validation set is created as per previous studies [ 7 , 1 ] for a fair comparison.
blocks.zh: 是公共的VinDR-Mammo数据集[19],由5000个全场数字乳房X光照相(FFDM)考试组成,每个考试有四个标准视图:左胸和右胸的圆柱斜面(CC)和中胸斜面(MLO)。 每次考试均由两名放射科医生独立双读,任何差异均由第三名放射科医生解决. 数据集包括乳房成像报告和数据系统(BI-RADS)之后的乳房层面说明,涵盖评估类别、乳房密度以及质量、钙化和建筑扭曲等调查结果。 特别是,数据集由典型的高乳房密度(密度C & D的90%)的越南人口的图像组成,这使得质量检测是一项具有挑战性的任务. 训练数据集共有15000幅图像,其中50%为普通图像,4000幅图像为测试数据集. 鉴定组按照以前的研究[7,1]建立,进行公平比较.

blocks.en: 3 Methods
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en: Grounding DINO (GDINO) [ 14 ] serves as our baseline model and is illustrated in the second half of Fig. 1 . This model is an open-vocabulary object detector that aligns local image features with semantic textual or referring expressions. GDINO builds upon the GLIP [ 10 ] framework, which utilizes “grounding” phrase information to bootstrap the detection decoder training. Through this process, the model learns semantically rich representations that enable detection using text-based queries, achieved via contrastive learning between image regions and language embeddings. GDINO achieves impressive performance by pretraining the backbone and the detection encoder-decoder end-to-end on 1.8 million image-text bounding box annotations and captions, enabling the decoder to effectively associate a vast array of visual features with corresponding text embeddings.
blocks.zh: 确定DINO(GDINO)[14]是我们的基准模型,图1的下半部分说明了这一点。 这个模型是一个开放的vocabulary对象探测器,它使局部的图像特征与语义的文字或引用表达式一致. GDINO以GLIP[10]框架为基础,该框架利用“打地”词条信息来引导探测解码器培训。 通过这个过程,该模型学习了精密丰富的表达方式,能够使用基于文本的查询进行检测,通过图像区域之间的对比性学习和语言嵌入来实现. GDINO通过在180万个图像文本边框注和标题上预先训练主干线和检测编码器-解码器端到端实现令人印象深刻的性能,使解码器能够有效地将大量视觉特征与相应的文本嵌入联系起来.

blocks.en: To approximate this level of performance within the medical domain, we initially explore the integration of anatomical and abnormality annotations from CXRs as a unified training set. Our objective was to explore whether increasing the number of medical annotations could improve the detection encoder-decoder’s ability to identify and represent clinically important characteristics effectively. However, due to the sparsity of class-specific annotations and class imbalance, training an object detector by simply combining multiple non-overlapping datasets often results in catastrophic forgetting. This significantly degrades both classification and detection performance [ 26 ] . In the natural image domain, several studies [ 26 , 3 ] have demonstrated the effectiveness of pseudo-labelling techniques to unify label spaces across datasets with overlapping annotations. Conversely, the medical imaging domain, especially CXRs, present additional challenges. The anatomical and abnormality categories are inherently non-overlapping and share similar visual characteristics, leading to potential interference during training. This feature similarity limits the applicability of conventional pretraining and pseudo-labeling methods in the CXR domain. To address these challenges, we adopt a student–teacher training strategy, from Zhao et al. [ 26 ] , which effectively combines anatomical and abnormality datasets while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.
blocks.zh: 为了在医学领域内估计这种水平的性能,我们最初探索将CXRs的解剖学和异常学说明作为统一的训练集进行整合. 我们的目标是探讨增加医疗说明的数量是否能够提高检测编码器-解码器有效识别和代表临床重要特征的能力。 然而,由于班级特有说明和班级不平衡的繁复,通过简单地结合多个非重叠数据集来训练物体探测器,往往导致灾难性的遗忘. 这大大降低了分类和检测性能[26]。 在自然图像领域,有几项研究[26,3]证明了伪标签技术在将各数据集的标签空间与重复说明统一起来的有效性. 相反,医学成像领域,特别是CXR,带来了额外的挑战。 解剖学和异常学的类别本质上是非重叠的,具有相似的视觉特征,导致在训练过程中的潜在干扰. 这个特征相似性限制了常规预训和伪标签方法在CXR域中的适用性. 为了应付这些挑战,我们采用了赵等人的学生-教师培训战略。 [26],它有效地结合解剖和异常数据集,同时减轻灾难性的遗忘.

blocks.en: Fig. 1 depicts the training process of developing a foundation model with exclusive CXR images. First, individual models ℳ A , ℳ B , ℳ C \mathcal{M}_{A},\mathcal{M}_{B},\mathcal{M}_{C} are trained on their respective datasets 𝒜 , ℬ , 𝒞 \mathcal{A},\mathcal{B},\mathcal{C} using domain-specific labels. These models then serve as teachers to generate pseudo-annotations for missing classes in the other datasets. Specifically, for each dataset 𝒟 ∈ { 𝒜 , ℬ , 𝒞 } \mathcal{D}\in\{\mathcal{A},\mathcal{B},\mathcal{C}\} , the corresponding teacher models ℳ D \mathcal{M}_{D} with 𝒟 ′ ≠ 𝒟 \mathcal{D}^{\prime}\neq\mathcal{D} predict annotations for classes absent in 𝒟 \mathcal{D} . Predictions with confidence scores above a class-specific threshold τ c \tau_{c} are retained as weak annotations, where τ c \tau_{c} is set to 95% sensitivity on the Reciever-Operating-Curve (ROC) curve for class c c [ 2 ] . For example, model ℳ C \mathcal{M}_{C} trained on dataset 𝒞 \mathcal{C} predicts the 16 abnormalities on dataset 𝒜 \mathcal{A} , as well as non-overlapping abnormalities in dataset ℬ \mathcal{B} . This process repeats until all datasets contain annotations for all classes in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} , effectively unifying the label space.
blocks.zh: 图1描绘了开发具有独家CXR图像的基础模型的培训过程. 首先,单个模型M A,M B,M \ mathcal{M}_{A},\mathcal{M}_{B},\mathcal{M}_{C}在各自的数据集A,B,C\mathcal{A},\mathcal{B}上接受过使用域特定标签的培训. 这些模型随后充当教师,为其他数据集中的缺课生成伪注释. 具体来说,每个数据集 D { { A, B, C }\ mathcal{ D}\in\{\ mathcal{ A},\ mathcal{ B},\ mathcal{ C } 对应的师范模型 M D \ mathcal{ M}_{D} 与 D { mathcal{ D}^{\prime}\neq\ mathcal{ D} 对 D\ mathcal{ D} 缺席的课进行预测说明 。 置信分数高于特定类别阈值的预测 \ c\ tau\ c} 保留为弱说明, 其中 c\ tau\ c} 设定为 c 类的 Reciever- Operating- Curve (ROC) 曲线的 95% 敏感度 。 例如,在数据集C\mathcal{M}_{C}上培训的模型M C\mathcal{C}预测数据集A\mathcal{A}上的16个异常,以及数据集B\mathcal{B}中的非重叠异常. 此进程会重复到所有数据集包含 C\ mathcal{ C} 中所有类的注释, 有效统一标签空间 。

blocks.en: For anatomy predictions from 𝒜 \mathcal{A} and ℬ \mathcal{B} , we select the top prediction per image and class without thresholding. We filter predictions by bounding box size and location to exclude those that are disproportionately large or small relative to the image, indicating significant Intersection-Over-Union (IoU) errors. Finally, a foundation model is trained using the combination of all annotations with both strong and weak annotations. We refer to this as the Anatomy-Abnormality Foundation Model (AAFM).
blocks.zh: 对于来自 A\ mathcal{A} 和 B\ mathcal{B} 的解剖学预测, 我们选择每个图像和类的顶端预测, 不设阈值 。 我们通过边框大小和位置来过滤预测,以排除相对于图像不成比例的大小,显示重大的交叉-超联盟(IoU)错误。 最后,一个基础模型是采用所有说明的组合,同时带有强弱说明. 我们将此称为解剖学-异常学基础模型(AAFM).

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of EM-DETR [ 1 ] detection. An exemplar feature embedding is generated for each class and interleaved with the text embedding. The detection encoder/decoder perform cross-attention between the image and interleaved embeddings, thereby training the decoder to search for classes based on their correlated text phrases as well as class-specific features.
blocks.zh: 图2:EM-DETR[1]检测概况. 每个类都生成一个示例特征嵌入,并与文本嵌入互换. 检测编码器/解码器在图像和间叶嵌入之间进行交叉切入,从而训练解码器根据其相关文本短语和类特异性搜索课程.

blocks.en: Next, we incorporate annotations from other domains, which may share similar textual labels but differ visually, and use our previously introduced example-based SOTA method, EM-DETR [ 1 ] , to train a second foundation model that unifies the multi-domain representation space. Fig. 2 shows the overview of EM-DETR [ 1 ] . EM-DETR is based on GDINO [ 25 , 14 ] , guiding detection through “class-specific exemplar embeddings” along with language. These examples are based on visual characteristics obtained from the region of interest (annotated section) of certain categories, facilitating a “example-based search”. The framework integrates exemplar generation, supplementary loss functions, and an “iterative” training approach to improve robustness and performance.
blocks.zh: 其次,我们纳入了来自其他域的说明,这些域可能具有相似的文字标签,但视线不同,并使用我们先前引入的基于实例的SOTA方法EM-DETR [1],来训练第二个统一多域代表空间的基础模型. 图2显示了EM-DETR [1]. EM-DETR基于GDINO [25, 14],通过“特定类的插图”以及语言指导检测。 这些例子基于从某些类别感兴趣的区域(附加说明的一节)获得的视觉特征,便利了“以实例为基础的搜索”。 该框架综合了示范生成、补充损失功能和“强制性”培训方法,以提高稳健性和绩效。

blocks.en: we use a frozen Swin [ 15 ] Transformer image backbone to extract shifted window patch embeddings 𝐗 ′ \mathbf{X}^{\prime} and positional encodings 𝐏 ′ \mathbf{P}^{\prime} for a given input image. For each class k k , tokens 𝐗 k \mathbf{X}_{k} and 𝐏 k \mathbf{P}_{k} are selected using annotations, and are used to compute 𝐇 k \mathbf{H}_{k} . This is mathematically denoted as:

blocks.en: 𝐇 k = 𝐗 k + a k × 𝐏 ′ where ​ k ​ denotes the class. \mathbf{H}_{k}=\mathbf{X}_{k}+a_{k}\times\mathbf{P}^{\prime}\quad\text{where }k\text{ denotes the class.} (1) a k a_{k} is a learnable scalar parameter that modulates the impact of the positional embeddings 𝐏 k \mathbf{P}_{k} . The positional information provides crucial cues to the decoder, given that certain CXR findings exhibit global spatial patterns, while others are restricted to localized anatomical regions. 𝐇 k \mathbf{H}_{k} is passed to a trainable Transformer module ℱ \mathcal{F} , which generates the representative class-specific feature embedding prototype 𝐪 k \mathbf{q}_{k} , expressed as: 𝐪 k = ℱ ⁡ ( concat ⁡ ( 𝐜𝐭 k , 𝐜𝐞 k , 𝐇 k ) ) + 𝐜𝐭 k + 𝐜𝐞 k , \mathbf{q}_{k}=\mathcal{F}\big(\mathrm{concat}(\mathbf{ct}_{k},\mathbf{ce}_{k},\mathbf{H}_{k})\big)+\mathbf{ct}_{k}+\mathbf{ce}_{k}, (2) where 𝐜𝐭 k \mathbf{ct}_{k} and 𝐜𝐞 k \mathbf{ce}_{k} , are class-specific learnable token and positional embeddings. To stabilize learning, a moving average of 𝐪 k \mathbf{q}_{k} is computed and stored in a “memory bank” as 𝐞 k \mathbf{e}_{k} . Exemplar embeddings are interleaved with text embeddings to facilitate the creation of hypothesis regions by the decoder. These regions are formed by contrasting the correlation between image embeddings and the interleaved embeddings. Two additional losses called ℒ c ​ o ​ n ​ t ​ r ​ a ​ s ​ t \mathcal{L}_{contrast} and ℒ f ​ e ​ a ​ t \mathcal{L}_{feat} are also introduced. These losses enforce orthogonality between class exemplar embeddings 𝐞 k \mathbf{e}_{k} and ensure the decoder’s top proposal aligns with the respective 𝐞 k \mathbf{e}_{k} , consequently ensuring class-specific uniformity.

blocks.en: Although these mechanisms define how the model learns class-specific representations, its effectiveness also depends on the training strategy and dataset composition. The contrastive loss learning scheme affects the model’s performance based on training class selection. Furthermore, the characteristics of various normal anatomical structures are similar to diverse findings. Thus, an iterative training approach is adopted, where the model is incrementally improved based on the output of each stage. The first stage foundation model employs all the annotations of dataset ℬ \mathcal{B} , 𝒞 \mathcal{C} and ℳ \mathcal{M} .
blocks.zh: 虽然这些机制界定了模型如何学习具体班级的表述,但其有效性也取决于培训战略和数据集组成。 对比性的损失学习计划会影响该模式根据培训课的选修情况。 此外,各种正常解剖结构的特征与不同的发现类似. 因此,采用了迭代培训方法,根据每个阶段的产出逐步改进模式。 第一阶段的基础模型使用所有数据集 B\ mathcal{B}, C\ mathcal{C} 和 M\ mathcal{M} 的注释 。

blocks.en: Figure 3: Overview of training the EM-DETR based foundation model, called EM-FM. In the first stage, all available radiology datasets are used to pretrain the detection encoder/decoder pair. The decoder is trained to detect medical features that correlate to specific text embeddings. In the second stage, the weights are refined for class-specific detection using a small subset of foreground vs. background annotations. The background annotations are generated based on data availability [ 1 ] .
blocks.zh: 图3:EM-DETR基础模型培训概况,称为EM-FM. 在第一阶段,所有可用的放射学数据集都用于预训检测编码器/解码器对子. 解码器经过培训,可检测与特定文字嵌入相关的医疗特征。 在第二阶段,使用一个小子集的前缘对背景说明,对重量进行细化,以进行分类特定检测. 背景说明是根据数据的可得性[1]生成的。

blocks.en: In the second stage, model weights are refined using a per-class background-versus-foreground dataset. The background annotations are generated by selecting regions from the known normal images. To select suitable background regions, we utilize a set of known locations of the findings within the training dataset. This process aims to capture the normal anatomies that must be distinguished for those specific findings. During inference the annotated regions are not available, and the stored 𝐞 k \mathbf{e}_{k} are used to guide detection. This is indicated as dotted lines in Fig. 2 . This model is referred to as the EM-DETR Foundation Model (EM-FM). 𝒜 \mathcal{A} was excluded in EM-FM, as combining multiple domains resulted in a large number of annotations, reducing the need for auxiliary anatomical supervision.
blocks.zh: 在第二阶段,模型权重使用每类背景与前置数据集进行精细化. 背景说明是通过从已知的普通图像中选择区域生成的. 为了选择合适的背景区域,我们利用一套已知的培训数据集中的调查结果位置。 这个过程旨在捕捉那些必须区别于这些具体结果的正常解剖. 在推断期间,没有附加说明的区域,所储存的e k\ mathbf{e}_{k}用于指导检测。 这在图2中以虚线表示。 这种模型被称为EM-DETR基础模型(EM-FM). 一个\mathcal{A}在EM-FM中被排除在外,因为结合多个域产生了大量的说明,减少了辅助解剖监督的需要.

blocks.en: 3.1 Evaluation criteria
blocks.zh: 3.1 评价标准

blocks.en: We evaluate image-level classification and localization performance for baseline, SOTA, and foundational models. For classification, the maximum predicted probability for each class within an image is recorded to compute the area under the ROC curve (AUC) score. Localization accuracy is assessed using mean Average Precision at 50% IoU m ​ A ​ P 50 mAP_{50} , following the COCO protocol in MMDetection [ 4 ] . We also assess the model’s Free-response Receiver Operating Characteristic (FROC) curve by measuring sensitivity across false positive (FP) rates. The FROC curve represents a more practical metric for diagnostic lesion detection systems, where the precise delineation of the boundaries of complex findings [ 20 , 13 , 6 , 11 ] is contentious. Sensitivity is calculated based on the distance between the centers of predicted regions and groundtruth annotations.
blocks.zh: 我们评价基线、SOTA和基础模型的图像级分类和本地化性能。 对于分类,记录一个图像内每个类的最大预测概率,以计算ROC曲线(AUC)分数下的区域. 本地化精度评估采用平均精度为50%的IoU m A P 50 mAP_{50},遵循MM检测中的COCO协议[4]. 我们还通过测量假正率(FP)的敏感度来评估该模型的自由响应接收器操作特征曲线。 FROC曲线是诊断性损伤检测系统的一个更为实用的衡量标准,其中对复杂发现的界限的精确划分[20、13、6、11]有争议。 敏感性是根据预测区域中心与地面真实说明之间的距离计算的。

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 4 实验结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: Experiments were conducted on a single node with four 40 GB A100 GPUs, within the MMDetection framework [ 4 ] . Default data augmentations and hyper-parameters were applied. The Swin-L backbone used a per-GPU batch size of 1, with a learning rate of 0.0008. Standard CXR-related augmentations such as random auto-contrast, sharpness adjustments, and random horizontal flipping, were added to the default augmentation pipeline. Furthermore, additional terms such as “right lung” and “left lung” were added to the text vocabulary, allowing the creation of distinct tokens for the intended left and right categories. Predictions from the anatomy teacher below 0.8 score and deviations greater than 50% from the average size of the ground truth were excluded. For mammogram images, the background dark regions were cropped, and the annotations were recalculated for the resized images. Each experiment was conducted five times, training upto 25 epochs. The reported results correspond to the mean performance calculated from the top 5 check points selected based on m ​ A ​ P 50 mAP_{50} .
blocks.zh: 在MM检测框架内用四个40 GB A100 GPU在一个单节点上进行了实验[4]. 采用了默认数据扩增和超参数。 Swin-L骨干采用每GPU批量尺寸1,学习率0.0008. 与CXR相关的标准增强,如随机自动相容,锐度调整,以及随机水平翻转等,被添加到默认增强管道中. 此外,在文字词汇中增加了“右肺”和“左肺”等词语,允许为预定的左类和右类设定不同的符号。 解剖师的预测值低于0.8分,与地面真相平均大小的偏差超过50%,但被排除. 对于乳房外观图像,背景暗区域被裁剪,对调整后的图像则重新计算说明. 每个实验都进行了五次,培训时间长达25个世纪。 报告的结果与从根据m A P 50 mAP _{50}选择的前5个检查点中得出的平均业绩相对应。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with SOTA
blocks.zh: 4.2 与SOTA的比较

blocks.en: Table 2 presents the image-level AUC results for four key CXR findings. It compares our method against the commercial Reference Product Solution (RPS) [ 6 ] , which is based on ResNet-101 FCOS [ 24 ] solution, as well as the baseline GDINO model. The RPS and baseline is trained solely on Dataset ℬ \mathcal{B} , AAFM and EM-FM are trained on 𝒜 \mathcal{A} - G and ℬ , 𝒞 , ℳ \mathcal{B},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{M} respectively. We observe that AAFM outperforms SOTA with a statistically significant 1% point improvement in the average AUC ( p < 0.05 p<0.05 ) score. This gain can be attributed to the effective integration of multiple datasets and the increased model capacity. Notably, when datasets are naively combined, the classification score for pneumothorax drops to 0.75, highlighting the importance of our integration strategy. The RPS [ 6 ] , while demonstrating strong performance, benefits from large-scale pretraining on 100 million images and relies on Non-Maximum Suppression (NMS) for post-processing.
blocks.zh: 表2显示四个关键CXR结果的图像级AUC结果。 它将我们的方法与基于ResNet-101 FCOS [24] 解决方案的商业参考产品解决方案(RPS)[6]以及基线GDINO模型进行比较. RPS和基线只接受Dataset B\mathcal{B}的培训,AAFM和EM-FM分别接受A\mathcal{A}-G和B,C,M\mathcal{B},\mathcal{C},\mathcal{M}的培训. 我们注意到,AAFM的表现超过了SOTA,在统计学上,AUC平均分提高1%(p < 0.05 p < 0.05). 这一增益可归因于多个数据集的有效整合和模型能力的增强. 值得注意的是,当数据集天真地合并时,肺炎的分类分数下降到0.75,凸显了我们整合战略的重要性. RPS[6]在展现强性能的同时,还得益于对1亿幅图像的大规模预训,并依靠非马克思姆抑制(NMS)进行后处理.

blocks.en: Table. 3 compares the m ​ A ​ P 50 mAP_{50} of the foundation models with the baseline and previous SOTA EM-DETR across CXR and mammogram findings. Compared to the baseline, EM-FM achieved substantial and statistically significant gains in CXR detection, with improvements of 14.6, 51.2 and 13.7% points for consolidation, pleural effusion and pneumothorax, respectively. This translates to an average of 19.9% point increase in m ​ A ​ P 50 mAP_{50} (0.567 vs. 0.369, p < 0.05 p<0.05 ). Compared to EM-DETR, EM-FM improved m ​ A ​ P 50 mAP_{50} by 2-6% points across these findings, and also outperformed EM-DETR in mammography by 2.2% points.

blocks.en: The limited gains in atelectasis detection are attributed to inherent labelling ambiguity stemming from clinical overlap with conditions like consolidation and distalectasis. These findings often share similar radiological features and may represent different stages along a pathological spectrum, leading to noisy or inconsistent groundtruth annotations across datasets. On the other hand, although AAFM underperforms on atelectasis and pleural effusion, relative to the baseline, these differences are not statistically significant. This gap stems from classification-optimized confidence thresholds in student-teacher training and variability in GDINO’s contrastive learning, which depends on the chosen classes for evaluation.
blocks.zh: 在非电子病检测方面进展有限,是因为临床上与合并和散射等情况重叠,造成固有的标签模糊。 这些发现往往具有相似的辐射特征,并可能代表病理谱的不同阶段,导致各数据集的地面真实说明吵闹或不连贯。 另一方面,虽然相对于基线而言,AAFM在electasis和胸膜充电方面的表现不佳,但这些差异在统计学上并不显著。 这一差距源于对学生-教师培训的分类-优化信任阈值和GDINO的对比性学习的可变性,这取决于选择的班级进行评价。

blocks.en: Table. 4 compares the sensitivity at 0.5 FP between the RPS [ 6 ] , baseline, and foundation models for four CXR findings. While the RPS leads with an average sensitivity of 0.954, EM-FM remains competitive at 0.927, despite a significant drop in atelectasis sensitivity. AAFM has significant lower sensitivity for atelectasis but excels in pneumothorax, while the naive combination of datasets yields a sensitivity of 0.18 for pneumothorax. These results demonstrate effective multi-dataset integration with EM-FM maintaining robust detection performance. Fig. 4 showcases qualitative samples of pleural effusion, pneumothorax on CXR images, and mass predictions in mammograms. We observe that the predictions produce smaller, more precise bounding boxes that align closely with the annotated regions.

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 5 , leveraging foundation models not only improves performance but also accelerates and stabilizes training convergence compared to the baseline. The EM-FM model reaches higher m ​ A ​ P mAP values overall, demonstrating the benefits of pretrained visual representations for faster optimization. This observation aligns with prior large-scale pretraining literature. It is important to note that the baseline performance can exhibit considerable variability. This instability primarily arises from its reliance on contrastive learning, where the model attempts to simultaneously optimize for both detection and contrastive objectives across multiple classes. Consequently, the performance is highly dependent on the specific set of classes used during training, as the model must balance the representation of each class while learning discriminative features. This intrinsic sensitivity to class selection can lead to fluctuations in baseline results, particularly when the dataset contains classes with differing levels of difficulty or prevalence. Conversely, owing to their example-based learning paradigm, the EM-DETR and EM-FM models generally exhibit more stable performance when trained on a large number of classes. This stability arises from their ability to leverage learned feature representations to match examples, rather than relying solely on class-dependent contrastive language objectives. As a result, these models are less sensitive to class selection and distribution, enabling more consistent detection performance across diverse and heterogeneous datasets.
blocks.zh: 如图5所示,与基线相比,利用基础模型不仅能提高绩效,而且能加速和稳定培训的趋同。 EM-FM模型整体上达到了更高的m A P mAP值,证明了预先训练的视觉表现对更快优化的好处. 此观察与之前的大规模预训文献一致 。 必须指出,基线业绩可能显示相当大的变化。 这种不稳定主要源于对对比性学习的依赖,在这种学习中,模型试图同时优化各种类别中的检测和对比目标。 因此,业绩高度依赖培训期间使用的具体班级,因为模式必须平衡每个班级的代表性,同时学习歧视性特征。 这种对类别选择的内在敏感性可能导致基线结果的波动,特别是在数据集包含难度或普遍程度不同的类别时. 相反,由于EM-DETR和EM-FM模式以实例为基础的学习模式,在接受大量课程培训时,其表现一般较为稳定。 这种稳定性产生于他们利用学到的特征表述与实例相匹配的能力,而不是仅仅依赖依赖阶级的对比性语言目标。 因此,这些模型对类选择和分布的敏感度较低,使得不同和多样的数据集的检测性能更加一致.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: This study explores creating a detection foundation model for all radiography images across multiple modalities. We first demonstrate that the combination of disjoint and overlapping set of anatomy and abnormality datasets, achieves SOTA classification performance. In contrast to their naive combination, we prevent catastrophic forgetting by weakly labelling missing annotations using a student-teacher approach. While not specifically optimizing for localization, we achieve comparable capabilities for most conditions, with the exception of atelectasis. We then incorporate all available CXR and mammography data into our previously proposed example-based detection model EM-DETR, resulting in significant detection improvements over prior SOTA across both modalities. Leveraging foundation models also facilitates faster and more stable training convergence, as widely reported in foundation model research. Future work will extend this approach to additional findings and datasets to further validate its generalizability and robustness.
blocks.zh: 本研究探索为所有跨多种模式的射线图像创建检测基础模型. 我们首先证明,解剖与异常数据集的脱节和重叠组合,实现了SOTA分类性能. 与其天真结合相反,我们避免了灾难性的遗忘,我们用学生-教师的方法,用微弱的标签来标记缺失的说明。 虽然没有具体优化本地化,但我们在大多数条件下都取得了可比较的能力,但非电子化除外. 然后,我们将所有可用的CXR和乳房X光学数据纳入我们先前提出的以实例为基础的EM-DETR检测模型,从而大大改进了以往跨两种模式的SOTA。 如基础模型研究广泛报告的那样,利用基础模型也有助于更快和更稳定的培训趋同。 今后的工作将把这一办法扩大到更多的调查结果和数据集,以进一步验证其普遍性和稳健性。
